items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: my other trumpet player that I was so proud of was Harold Baker

ctx.x: Yeah, mention something about him, because he was fabulous.

Yeah, he was a fabulous trumpet player, and I don't know what happened to Karl; I think after my band broke up, I think he went with Stan Kenton for awhile, and then I lost track of him. And then my other trumpet player that I was so proud of was Harold Baker, who --
